messages.subject: fileInput - cannot upload files
parts:
I am using fileInput control in my commercial project deployed to shinyapps.io

Several files are not uploaded to the server and this error message is logged:

Error</h1><pre>/usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:65: attempt to index local 'curr' (a boolean value)</pre><h2>Traceback</h2><pre> stack traceback: /usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:65: in function 'add_params' /usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:394: in function 'handler' /usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:416: in function </usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:412> [C]: in function 'xpcall' /usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/application.lua:412: in function 'dispatch' /usr/share/luajit/share/lua/5.1/lapis/nginx.lua:181: in function 'serve' access_by_lua(redx.conf:157):1: in function <access_by_lua(redx.conf:157)

Looks like the upload fails for some specific file content (strange, what's the difference for the upload tool what content uploaded file has), I found a similar issue reported by other users and the fix was to remove ampersand character from the file! I cannot do this because it is a binnary file.

When I run the same application locally file gets uploaded correclty, so for me it seems to be shinyapps.io problem. I can also reproduce the problem on one of the examples that I found on shiny/rstudio tutorial (https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-examples/tree/master/009-upload)

Any help would be appreciated.

regards, Adam
